posts.title: two steps back
posts.description: I was going to write about life in a physical rehab facility, but now I’m back in the hospital instead. Steps back indeed: I am not judged ready to do that, and must lie in bed until my tuckus aches.

posts.title: jabbed and otherwise assaulted
posts.description: Yesterday afternoon I went in for my flu and covid shots. Unlike others reporting this year, I did not feel seriously wiped out by the shots. But that may be because I was already so enervated that there was no more wiped out to get. I've been using a cane when I walk for some years now.
